How these streets are selected

At least 10 confidently matched vehicle reports on at least 5 distinct dates, with no more than one bike-lane ticket per two reports in the selected period. Ordered by the lowest ticket-to-report ratio, then the most reports. These are screening thresholds, not an enforcement standard.

A report is not a confirmed missed ticket. BLU reports may not have reached the city; other violation codes may apply; and reporting intensity varies by street. This ratio is not a response rate.

Screening leads, not proof of ignored complaints. Reports may not have reached the city, and a vehicle obstruction may receive a different ticket code. Reporter activity is uneven. Intersection ambiguity and address errors remain.
